FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeUrl.Name: Bridge WebSocket URL
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeUrl.Hint: WebSocket endpoint exposed by the MCP server. Saving this setting reconnects immediately.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeSecret.Name: Bridge secret
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeSecret.Hint: Shared secret used for challenge authentication. Saving this setting reconnects immediately. Visible to GMs only.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.Notifications.Name: Show notifications
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.Notifications.Hint: Show a Foundry notification after mutating operations.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.Diagnostics.Name: Diagnostic logging
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.Diagnostics.Hint: Log connection diagnostics. Secrets and payloads are never logged.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.AssistantSetup.Name: Offer assistant account setup
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.AssistantSetup.Hint: On the next full-GM login, offer to create the dedicated headless MCP user. Disable this after creation or dismissal.
